step.command: OVERLAY_DIR=/home/yunwei37/workspace/bpf-benchmark/runner/config/passes/map_inline/overlays/katran; CH=; RE=; SI=; for f in ${MAP_VALUES}/map-*.show.json; do n=$(jq -r .name "$f"); i=$(jq -r .id "$f"); case "$n" in ch_rings) CH=$i ;; reals) RE=$i ;; server_id_map) SI=$i ;; esac; done; jq -n --arg c "$CH" --arg r "$RE" --arg s "$SI" --slurpfile co "$OVERLAY_DIR/ch_rings.json" --slurpfile ro "$OVERLAY_DIR/reals.json" --slurpfile so "$OVERLAY_DIR/server_id_map.json" '($c | if . == "" then {} else {(.): $co[0]} end) + ($r | if . == "" then {} else {(.): $ro[0]} end) + ($s | if . == "" then {} else {(.): $so[0]} end)' > ${MAP_VALUES}/overlays.json && timeout 6000 bpfopt --pass map_inline --input ${INPUT} --output ${OUTPUT} --report ${REPORT} --prog-type ${PROG_TYPE} --verifier-states ${VERIFIER_STATES} -- --map-values ${MAP_VALUES} --map-ids ${MAP_IDS} --inline-hint=ctl_array:!00000000 --inline-hint=vip_map:!0a6401010000000000000000000000001f900600 --inline-hint=ch_rings:!00000000 --inline-hint=reals:!01000000 --inline-hint=server_id_map:!00000000 # lpm_src_v4/v6 hints commented: katran is built without # -DLPM_SRC_LOOKUP, so these maps are guarded out of the program # by `#ifdef LPM_SRC_LOOKUP` in balancer_maps.h. bpfopt fail-fasts # on hint anchor not in metadata (correct: catches typos and # mis-applied hints early). Uncomment if a future build turns on # source-IP routing. # --inline-hint=lpm_src_v4:!00000000 # --inline-hint=lpm_src_v6:!00000000 # lru_mapping/global_lru_maps outer-only hints commented: katran # benchmark uses F_LRU_BYPASS + no `-forwarding_cores`, so the outer # ARRAY_OF_MAPS stays empty (every slot ENOENT). #265 root-caused this: # `attachLrus()` iterates empty forwardingCores_ → zero update_elem. # bpfopt fail-fasts when hinted outer key has no live inner map # (correct: hint claims something kernel snapshot disproves). # Uncomment only if benchmark configures forwarding cores OR an # alternative test deploys populated map-in-map. # --inline-hint=lru_mapping:!00000000 # --inline-hint=global_lru_maps:!00000000
